full_judgment: 12. The High Court Division came to a finding that the plaintiff failed to prove his title to the suit land and that he was dispossessed from the 'Kha' schedule land by the defendants and that the suit was filed within the statutory period of limitation. The High Court Division also found that on proper appreciation of the evidence both oral and documentary, the trial Court came to the conclusion that the plaintiff failed to prove his case on all counts. The High Court Division noticed that the suit was filed against the Union Parishad without observing the legal formalities as stipulated in law and that on this count also the suit was not maintainable. The High Court Division found that the appellate Court only on the basis of mere presumption set aside the findings and decision attired at by the trial Court.
